title: Gateway upgrade will penalize old graph-node / indexer-service versions
summary: Testnet this week, mainnet next week. Minimum versions: graph-node v0.36.0, indexer-service v1.7.0. Only affects query selection scoring — indexing rewards unaffected.
body:
In the next couple of days we will be rolling out a gateway upgrade that will (indirectly) penalize scoring in the selection algorithm for indexers serving queries with old versions of graph-node / indexer-service. This will only affect indexer's chance of getting selected to serve queries, indexing rewards are not affected at all. The upgrade will hit testnet later this week, and mainnet next week.

The minimum versions to avoid this are:
• graph-node v0.36.0
• indexer-service v1.7.0

Indexers that need to take action (only includes indexers with a reachable URL):
• 0x2e15f3...b47a — swift-staking.com → Update indexer-service to v1.7.0 or greater
• 0xdecba5...cbb5 — decisionbasis.cc → Update indexer-service to v1.7.0 or greater
• 0x1b92e4...788c — thegraph.vincenttaglia.com → Update graph-node to v0.36.0 or greater
• 0x59749d...f54 — gunu-node.com → Unknown graph-node version, please check

title: Indexing rewards deprecated for Substreams-powered Subgraphs effective April 16th
summary: Indexers must close allocations or submit POIs between April 13–15 to collect accrued rewards. Follows GIP 0084 — rewards now focus on chains with sustained query volume and active developer usage.
body:
Indexing rewards will be deprecated for Substreams-powered Subgraphs effective April 16th, 2026.

Important Action Steps:
Indexers will need to close allocations or submit POIs between April 13th and April 15th to ensure that you collect accrued rewards.

Additional Context:
Following GIP 0084, The Graph Network is refining how protocol resources, particularly indexing rewards, are allocated. Rewards will now focus on chains and features that demonstrate:
• Sustained query volume
• Strong ecosystem adoption
• Active developer usage
